split: deterministic 70/30 dev/heldout within each class, ordered by sha256(seed + case id)
origin: authored-synthetic; no real resumes, postings or replies

supabase/functions/_shared/provenance/fi.role: synthetic profile the guard cases cite

tests/helpers.ts.role: repairedProfile() used by the guard runner

note: Re-frozen 2026-10-24 before any execution (edition 1 has never run). Hashes are sha256 of the LF-normalized working-file bytes; after commit they also equal the git blob content. Any change to a case or the fixture profile after the first run requires a new edition.
labelConvention: expectedLabel = what the current, unquoted, unsigned message itself says; quoted-only, signature-only, negated and vague outcome hints are unknown; courtesy receipts stay acknowledgement (review expected); other-company messages keep their content label with expectReview=true; expectReview follows PLAN section 8 only, never the classifier's rule tiers; job alerts and newsletters expect no review
macroF1: average over labels with cases in the split; precision 0 for a label with support but no predictions
